تستكبروا (form X)
# تَسْتَكْبِرُوا (tastakbirū) /tas.tak.bi.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَكْبَرَ (istakbara)
# تُسْتَكْبَرُوا (tustakbarū) /tus.tak.ba.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَكْبَرَ (istakbara)
